messages:
anya: Heads-up  Privacy approved the new offboard retention appendix. Need a short handbook blurb, manager checklist, and tracking plan.

julie: I'll write a single-paragraph entry + a tiny FAQ. Prefer clear bullets.

olivia: Ops: we need a canonical export format to snapshot accounts before deprovision. Suggested CSV columns: employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial. Run 24h before deprovision.

sam: Managers will watch a 7min microtraining and click to ack within 7 days of an exit. Tracker: manager,employee_id,opt_in(Y/N),training_ack(Y/N),ack_ts.

kai: Proposed opt-in copy: "I consent to temporary retention of logs and backups for security or legal investigation (up to 12 months)." Short and explicit.

anya: Handbook draft sentence: "On separation, Redwood deletes personal account data within 30 days unless subject to a legal hold or active investigation; backups and logs may be retained up to 12 months for investigatory purposes. Employees will be offered an opt-in for short-term investigatory retention. Managers receive a checklist and must complete the brief recorded microtraining."

julie: LGTM. I'll add links to the retention policy doc and the e-sign form.

olivia: CLI snippet for infra:
```
# offboard snapshot for uid 11011
redwood-admin export --user 11011 --fields employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-11011.csv
```

hr-bot: Reminder set  Publish appendix to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager microtraining recording for 2026-08-01 09:00 PT.

anya: I'll post the handbook blurb, checklist slide, and tracker link after lunch. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
